channel_name.description: Required. Private channel to authorize. Tenant-scoped user channels follow the pattern private-App.Models.User.{tenantId}.{userId}. The authenticated user may only authorize their own channel for the active tenant; legacy un-scoped channels (private-App.Models.User.{id}) are always rejected.

socket_id.description: Required. The WebSocket connection's socket id, assigned by Reverb on connect (pusher protocol format: {number}.{number}).
